##### Project general facts

Damac Islands Phase 1 and 2 is a master-planned residential community inspired by some of the world’s most iconic tropical island destinations. The development features a mix of contemporary townhouses, luxury villas, and apartments designed to create a resort-style lifestyle environment centered around nature, water, and outdoor living. The project combines modern residential architecture with immersive island-inspired landscapes, offering residents a unique balance between tranquility and vibrant community living within a carefully planned setting.

The community offers an extensive selection of lifestyle and recreational amenities focused on wellness, adventure, and leisure. Residents can enjoy attractions such as the Aqua Dome, Wildlife Park, and Jungle River, alongside a wide variety of outdoor activities including kayaking, paddle boarding, and ziplining. Wellness-oriented facilities such as the Hot Spring Spa and overwater floating decks create a relaxing resort atmosphere, while outdoor fitness areas and calisthenics zones support an active lifestyle. The overall concept is designed to provide a highly experiential living environment inspired by tropical resort destinations.

The residences are fully finished using high-quality modern materials that emphasize contemporary comfort and functionality. Kitchens are equipped to support everyday convenience and modern living standards. The properties are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners flexibility in personalizing their interiors while maintaining the project’s clean and upscale residential aesthetic.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Lagoons is strategically located in one of Dubai’s most rapidly developing residential corridors, adjacent to Damac Hills and with direct access to major road networks including Hessa Street, Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street, and Emirates Road. This location allows residents to enjoy a peaceful, resort-style environment while remaining well connected to key destinations across the city. Major business districts, international airports, and popular leisure hubs can be reached conveniently, making the community attractive for both families and professionals.

One of the key advantages of the location is its unique balance between tranquility and accessibility. Unlike the dense urban core of Dubai, DAMAC Lagoons offers a low-rise, nature-oriented setting centered around water features, open spaces, and themed neighborhoods inspired by famous Mediterranean destinations. At the same time, residents are only a short drive from established communities, schools, healthcare facilities, shopping centers, and entertainment venues, ensuring that everyday conveniences are always within easy reach.

The area is particularly appealing for those seeking a lifestyle-driven community with long-term growth potential. Being situated next to the mature DAMAC Hills development allows residents to benefit from an already established infrastructure while enjoying the extensive recreational attractions of DAMAC Lagoons itself. The combination of waterfront-inspired living, family-friendly surroundings, strong connectivity, and continuous development in the surrounding area positions DAMAC Lagoons as one of Dubai’s most desirable suburban residential destinations.
